title: Ethoslab, Grian and Geminitay Chickens
description: Turns chickens and baby chickens into the hermits Ethoslab, Grian and Geminitay.
body:
Changes the chicken and new 26.1 baby chicken to look like Ethoslab, Grian and Geminitay, three creators from the popular minecraft server Hermitcraft.
![Showcase of all the textures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ee40f1013737efe6cf3045cd7b4ac8bf3402fa82.png)
